# `try_subtract`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

```text
try_subtract(expr1, expr2)
```

Returns `expr1`-`expr2` and the result is null on overflow. The acceptable input types are the same with the `-` operator.

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Implemented |
| Group | `math_funcs` |
| Kind | scalar (function) |
| Added in Spark | 3.3.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 3.5 and later |
| Arguments | 2 |
| Deterministic | yes |

## Examples

```sql
-- try_subtract, example 1
> SELECT try_subtract(2, 1);
1
```

```sql
-- try_subtract, example 2
> SELECT try_subtract(-2147483648, 1);
NULL
```

```sql
-- try_subtract, example 3
> SELECT try_subtract(date'2021-01-02', 1);
2021-01-01
```

```sql
-- try_subtract, example 4
> SELECT try_subtract(date'2021-01-01', interval 1 year);
2020-01-01
```

```sql
-- try_subtract, example 5
> SELECT try_subtract(timestamp'2021-01-02 00:00:00', interval 1 day);
2021-01-01 00:00:00
```

```sql
-- try_subtract, example 6
> SELECT try_subtract(interval 2 year, interval 1 year);
1-0
```
